author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Axis Reweighting β=0.75 (k=45)
abstract: Single-change on the 0.7296 SOTA: reweight whitened ComBat PCA axes by a batch-only, label-free concordance score (Pearson corr of |Δ_PC| with pooled cosine distance across cross-batch neighbors). Aim: modest ARI/NMI/ASW_label gains with mixing unchanged.
